report_variant_invalid.why: The report variant request is not valid: an unknown variant, an n outside 1..10, or an n or study_id without a variant. Nothing ran; the request is corrected.

report_variant_too_few_options.why: Fewer than 2 options have the NPV or IRR a report variant ranks by; the message names the options left out. Nothing ran.

option_compare_stale.why: The option compare is out of date, so a report variant would rank stale figures. Nothing ran; the compare is rerun first.
